WELCOME TO MUSEO TRES CULTURAS!!

Grupo Tres · Literatura Filipina Contemporánea

La historia vive en las palabras.

History lives in words.

Museo Tres Culturas is a Spanish-inspired name meaning “Museum of Three Cultures.” It symbolizes the rich and evolving identity of the Filipino people as expressed through contemporary Philippine literature. The word Tres refers to Grupo Tres (Group 3), the creators of this museum. Meanwhile, Culturas represents the diverse Filipino experiences, beliefs, struggles, and aspirations reflected in literary works. Together, the name signifies how literature preserves our past, reveals the realities of our society, and expresses the continuing evolution of Filipino culture and national identity.
